name: METAWATER Co., Ltd.
summary: METAWATER Co., Ltd. designs and constructs facilities for water treatment plants, sewage treatment plants, and waste treatment facilities in Japan and internationally. It operates in four segments: Environmental Engineering Business, System Solutions Business, Operation Business, and International segments.
